name: Mo Cháemóc
text: Mo Cháemóc, also styled St Caemhoc, Kemoc, Kevoge, or Kevoca, was a disciple of St Patrick. In Oidheadh Chlainne Lir, the tale of the Lir children's tragedy, Mo Cháemóc is the one who carries the Christian faith to the Children of Lir.

attributes.attribute: variants St Caemhoc, Kemoc, Kevoge, Kevoca

okr.objective: Documents Mo Cháemóc as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Mo Cháemóc was a disciple of St Patrick.
In Oidheadh Chlainne Lir he brings Christianity to the Children of Lir.
His name appears in several saintly spellings.
